none: PAS CAM-D829D1: Roman Coin : A Copper-alloy Nummus of Valens, AD364-378
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE ; D/ DN VALENS PF AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Valens, AD364-378. Mint is Aquileia, AD367-375, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left with wreath. See LRBC p.67, no.1015. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads DN VALENS PF AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: -/-//SMAQS. Condition is very fine, die axis is 12…
